description: MetaRalph Phase 5: Onboarding & Analysis Engine - Analyze new projects, extract TODOs, fetch issues, generate improvement proposals.

userStories.title: Implement codebase analyzer
userStories.description: As MetaRalph, I need to analyze codebases to find improvement opportunities when projects are added.
acceptanceCriteria: Detects: missing tests, outdated deps, type errors, lint issues
Runs: npm outdated, npm run typecheck, npm run lint (if available)
Categorizes findings by type and severity

userStories.title: Implement TODO/FIXME extractor
userStories.description: As MetaRalph, I need to find TODO and FIXME comments to create tasks from them.
acceptanceCriteria: Finds: TODO, FIXME, XXX, HACK, BUG comments
Extracts: type, content, file, line number
Uses git blame to find author and age
Priority: FIXME > BUG > TODO > XXX > HACK

userStories.title: Implement GitHub Issues fetcher
userStories.description: As MetaRalph, I need to fetch open issues from GitHub to create tasks from them.
acceptanceCriteria: fetch(projectPath) detects GitHub remote and fetches open issues
Uses GitHub MCP tools or gh CLI if available
Returns: title, body, labels, assignee, created_at
Filters to issues without 'wontfix' or 'invalid' labels
Maps issue labels to task types (bug -> bug_fix, enhancement -> feature)

userStories.title: Implement initial proposals generator
userStories.description: As MetaRalph, I need to generate improvement proposals when a project is onboarded.
acceptanceCriteria: Combines: codebase analysis, TODOs, GitHub issues
Creates initial conversation with proposals summary

userStories.title: Implement onboarding coordinator
userStories.description: As MetaRalph, I need to orchestrate the full onboarding flow when a project is added.
acceptanceCriteria: Pipeline: validate git repo -> analyze -> extract TODOs -> fetch issues -> generate proposals
